name: Hierarchical Grid with Macrocells
definition: A hierarchical grid structure that divides densely populated regions of space more finely than empty regions by imposing a coarser grid over the previous level, where each macrocell corresponds to an M × M × M block of cells in the underlying level.
summary: A hierarchical grid structure that replaces Boolean flags with parameter range culling to enable aggressive early-out tests during volume rendering traversal.
